g.text: PSYCHOLOGY
mind: think, feel,
learn, cope, grow
Freud · Pavlov · Piaget
SOCIOLOGY
groups: family, class,
roles, inequality
Parsons · norms
ANTHROPOLOGY
culture: beliefs,
rituals, healers
Kleinman · meanings
3 LENSES, 1 PATIENT: PSYCHOLOGY (her mind: fear? beliefs? learning?) · SOCIOLOGY
(her world: family? money? role? inequality?) · ANTHROPOLOGY (her meaning: what IS this
illness to her? spirits? punishment? test?). Rotate all three — single-lens care blinds.
PSYCHOLOGY SCHOOLS (exam names!): psychodynamic (Freud — unconscious, childhood, defences
— M03!) · behavioural (Pavlov/Skinner — learned habits, rewards — M05!) · cognitive (Beck
— thoughts shape feelings — M05/M06!) · humanistic (Maslow/Rogers — needs, growth, empathy
— COM!). Developmental: Piaget + Erikson + Bowlby (M02!).
SOCIOLOGY GIFTS: sick role (Parsons — rights + duties of "patient"!) · socialisation (how
we learn "nurse/patient/mother"!) · norms (ward rules, queues, visiting!) · inequality
(poverty sickens — M04 SDH!) · stigma (Goffman — spoiled identity — M06!).
ANTHROPOLOGY GIFTS: explanatory models (Kleinman — "what do YOU call this? what caused
it? what will heal it?" — ASK IT!) · medical pluralism (hospital + herbalist + pastor —
patients use ALL — negotiate, never mock! — NUT/COM!) · rituals (birth, death, healing —
make ROOM!).
SICK ROLE (Parsons — exam!): rights (exempt from duties + not blamed + cared for) + duties
(want recovery + seek proper help + cooperate!). Misuse? "Malingering" rare — assume need;
chronic illness strains the role (never "recovers" — support, don't judge!).
KLEINMAN'S 3 QUESTIONS (use weekly!): "what do you call this problem…? what do you think
caused it…? what do you think will heal it…?" — 60 seconds, whole belief-worlds revealed.
LINKS: COM M5 culture · NUT myths · GER roles · PRO-I respect.
MANTRA: "mind it, place it, mean it — psych, society, culture."
